children: Shares of Forward Industries fell after the company said it has entered a $25 million securities-purchase agreement with an institutional investor.
The stock was trading 5.4% lower at the opening bell, at $8.14. Through Tuesday's close, shares are up nearly 18% year to date.
Forward said it will sell about 3.13 million shares of its common stock in the direct offering at $8 apiece.
The Solana-focused digital-asset treasury company said it intends to use proceeds from the offering, expected to close on or about Thursday, to acquire additional SOL.
